text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
October—the most talked-about Umamusume of the moment
was sprinting forward, propelled by overwhelming expectations.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What incredible speed!
Silence Suzuka pulls away from the pack with a massive front-runner lead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow!! Is it really okay
to sprint out that fast!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Past the great zelkova, the trailing pack closes in, but—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Entering the straight, she accelerates again!!
The Umamusume behind her just can't close the gap!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This is the true power of the "Otherworldly Escape Artist"!
Silence Suzuka crosses the finish line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ever since returning from Hong Kong, her races have been incredible!
She is truly the greatest of great Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only is her running remarkably strong,
but it also captures the hearts of those who watch and never lets go.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Suzuka's
headed for the winner's circle yo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm going over to give a celebratory hug!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the area was overflowing with fans
celebrating Silence Suzuka's victory,
and I couldn't even get close to the Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing Silence Suzuka's current popularity made me deeply realize
that she truly is an Umamusume who 'leaves a lasting impression.'"
